Quick reflexes, smart weapon choices, and constant vigilance are your keys to surviving the nightmare.

Eliminate them one by one, sabotage critical systems, and avoid detection at all costs. Use vents to sneak around, trigger fake emergencies to lure crewmates, and strike when no one is watching. But be careful&mdash;the AI crewmates are always watching, and if they suspect you, it&rsquo;s game over. Can you outsmart the crew and take control of the ship?
